PC: Obtain a pertinent patient history to include an HPI, ROS, PMH, social/occupational history, and medications/allergies.
Perform a pertinent physical exam to include assessment of the patient’s skin, cardiovascular function, lungs, and abdomen.
Order appropriate laboratory tests to include complete blood count (CBC), basic metabolic panel (BMP), coagulation tests (PT, INR, PTT), serum lactic acid level, urinalysis, and blood cultures.
Provide appropriate supportive care to include fluids, broad spectrum antibiotics, and an antipyretic/analgesic.
MK: Recognize exposure to ionizing radiation and establish a diagnosis of ARS.
SBP: Consider the need for patient decontamination.
Consult appropriate disciplines, such as toxicology, hematology, internal medicine, REAC/TS, and/or the hospital’s radiation safety officer.
